visual_identity.core_identity: An enormous cave bat with a broad membrane wingspan, powerful clawed feet, and an unmistakable natural bat silhouette.
visual_identity.silhouette: Wide folded or partly opened wings, hanging inverted body, large pointed ears, narrow torso, clawed feet gripping overhead rock.
visual_identity.head_features: Natural bat face with large ears, short muzzle, small eyes, no monstrous humanoid features.
visual_identity.body_shape: Light flying mammal body with very long finger-boned wings and compact torso.
visual_identity.surface: Short fur on body and smooth wing membranes with minimal vein lines.

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
